en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 22. Abu Mansur Ahmad ibn Ibrahim ibn Bakr al-Khuri said in Naysabur that Abu Ishaq Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn Harun al-Khuri said: Ja`far ibn Muhammad ibn Ziyad the Jurist in al-Khuri said: Ahmad ibn `Abd Allah al-Juybari al-Shaybani said, on the authority of `Ali ibn Musa alRida, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his forefathers, on the authority of `Ali (AS) that The Messenger of Allah (SA) said: “
Verily, Allah, the Mighty and High, had decreed and planned everything two thousand years before He created Adam (AS).”
